flashpoints.name: Bourbon & BattleMechs
flashpoints.description: Commander. My name is Justin Allard. You don't know me, but I've heard a great deal about you. There is a small matter that I could use your assistance with, if you're so inclined. Meet me at your earliest convenience and we'll talk.

contracts.name: Bourbon & BattleMechs
contracts.description: The Stratford Narwhal is one of Garrilac's favorite watering holes. It's also a cesspool of vice, corruption, and terrible music. Taking it out may prove more difficult than you'd think; the bar was built in the husk of an old military complex, and its MechWarrior patrons will probably attack you on sight.

contracts.name: Bourbon & BattleMechs II
contracts.description: Garrilac's lance is on the ground and waiting for you. Destroy them.

reward.title: Rare Items
reward.description: This cache contains several rare items.

flashpoints.name: Criminal Minds
flashpoints.description: House Liao requires your assistance in the dismantling of a prominent crime syndicate. Working in concert with Capellan ground forces, you will capture the OpFor's personnel and seize their financial assets.

contracts.name: Criminal Minds
contracts.description: Commander, find and eliminate the Iron Sparrow's courier and his bodyguard. I want Shivraj dead and whatever intelligence he's carrying in my hands.

contracts.name: Criminal Minds II
contracts.description: The intel you got from the Iron Sparrow's courier points here, to the warehouse you'll find just ahead. Take it for House Liao until the Liao Reserves arrive to relieve you.

contracts.name: Criminal Minds III
contracts.description: The Iron Sparrow has dispatched all of his remaining units to attack the vault's northmost entrance, Commander. Hold them off until the Liao Reserves arrive to relieve you.

contracts.name: Criminal Minds III
contracts.description: I know what your man has done. Lady Marina may be fool enough to trust in mercenaries, but I've had agents watching you from the start—and now I find my suspicions confirmed. Prepare yourself to face the full wrath of the Liao Reserves, Commander—I will claim the contents of that vault you so covet, and then I will bury you in it.

reward.title: Uncommon Weapon
reward.description: This cache contains an improved version of a 'Mech weapon.

flashpoints.name: Davion Alliance
flashpoints.description: Our allies in the Federated Suns have a special request for us. They insist that they can only give us details in person.

contracts.name: Davion Alliance
contracts.description: As I mentioned, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, before we can begin operations on the planet, we need to neutralize an observation post. Conveniently, we can then use the facility's resources to stage further assaults. Our information suggests the base is quite well defended, which is unsurprising, given the planet's location on multiple potentially hostile borders. Once the base is taken, we won't have to worry about errant calls for reinforcements, but to be safe, it would be best for you to hunt down all enemy forces to prevent them from retreating and spreading word of the attack.

contracts.name: Davion Alliance II
contracts.description: With our beachhead secured, it is time to start moving against the Capellans here on Kern. There are multiple potential targets in the area, but before we discuss them, we need to clear the field. Our technicians have extracted the force deployment data from the base computers, and we know that there are two heavy lances of 'Mechs on patrol right now, somewhere on the other side of the river. You'll get in by Leopard and sweep the woods; eliminate any Capellan units you uncover.

contracts.name: Davion Alliance III
contracts.objective: Destroy Logistical Facility and Extract Safely
contracts.description: This logistical base is a key component of the Capellans' hold on this area of Kern. Any significant force in the region needs this base to remain operational and supplied in the field. The main facility is located in deep woods, well concealed and well defended. Expect heavy resistance before reaching it, and expect turret defenses at the base itself. A secondary base nearby houses technicians and staff; destroying it is not required, but if you manage to, it will ensure the main facility remains permanently closed and unrepairable.

contracts.name: Davion Alliance IV
contracts.objective: Destroy Lieutenant Colonel Song and Escape
contracts.description: Those aren't just reinforcements, Commander. That's our target: the CCAF commander, Lieutenant Colonel Song. As a reminder, they're a deadly MechWarrior as well as a skilled strategist. Their arrival on the field presents an opportunity—if we act swiftly, we can achieve our goals here on Kern in a single strike, making this world an easy pickup when we mount the full-scale attack. This is it, Commander. Don't screw this up.

contracts.name: Davion Alliance III
contracts.objective: Retrieve the Transmission Data and Extract Safely
contracts.description: The location of the bunker is extremely well concealed, presumably to prevent exactly the kind of orbital strike we're planning to make. For us to locate it, you'll need to download transmission data from a logistics base in the region. That should give us a rough location. The logistics base is likely to be well defended, but if we're going to keep from alerting the Capellans to our plan, you'll need to insert with a lighter lance than you may be used to. Remember that all we need is the data; any enemy forces present are incidental.

contracts.name: Davion Alliance IV
contracts.objective: Assault the Bunker and Designate a Target for the Fire Mission
contracts.description: The transmission data was enough for us to locate the fortified bunker that the regional Capellan command is hiding in. They think they're safe in there, but we've got a naval PPC on station ready to punch a hole in anything they've built down there. You'll need to move your 'Mechs into position so that we can make a precise attack; once we take this shot, our DropShip is going to have to break orbit and run, so there's only one chance to get this right. We have complete confidence in you, Commander; your judgment has been spot-on so far. Good luck.

reward.title: LosTech Items
reward.description: This cache contains several items, including at least one Star League era item.

flashpoints.name: Extracurricular Activities
flashpoints.description: I require your help on a personal matter, Commander. No other mercenary company will do. If you accept, further details will be provided upon your arrival at Brockway.

contracts.name: Extracurricular Activities
contracts.description: You'll find the Davion munitions factory at the coordinates I've outlined, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Take it from them, that it may serve as the bait for the trap that I'm paying you to set.

contracts.name: Extracurricular Activities II
contracts.description: Lord Jesper and his lance are on their way to challenge you. Hold the factory and send him home in his ejection pod, defeated and ashamed! Leave his precious ancestral BattleMech a smoldering ruin!

contracts.name: Extracurricular Activities II
contracts.objective: Escort the Refugees to Safety and Escape
contracts.description: We'd be dead without your assistance, Commander. Full stop. There are at least a dozen different bandit gangs operating on the outskirts of our territory, and any one of 'em would jump at the chance to gun us down. So… thanks for doing what's decent. From all of us.

contracts.name: Extracurricular Activities III
contracts.description: Now that your humanitarian responsibilities have been seen to, perhaps you'll be good enough to focus your attention on your real job? Lord Jesper and his lance are on their way to challenge you. Hold the factory and send him home in his ejection pod, defeated and ashamed! Leave his precious ancestral BattleMech a smoldering ruin!

reward.title: Rare Items
reward.description: This cache contains several rare items.

flashpoints.name: Headhunting
flashpoints.description: House Davion seeks your assistance in a sensitive matter related to the security of our national borders. Expect a short deployment with exceptional salvage opportunities.

contracts.name: Headhunting
contracts.description: Descend on the Flak Jackals and punch a hole in their lines. Make them pay for the Federation citizens they've killed, Commander—it is imperative that this pirate filth learn the cost of crossing the Federated Suns.

contracts.name: Headhunting II
contracts.description: Hunt down and eliminate Orchid "Thresher" Zhao, one of the two leaders of the Flak Jackals. Be advised that her personal BattleMech is equipped with LosTech weaponry and equipment.

contracts.name: Headhunting II
contracts.description: Hunt down and eliminate Dominik "Whistler" Zhao, one of the two leaders of the Flak Jackals. Be advised that his personal BattleMech is equipped with LosTech weaponry and equipment.

reward.title: Rare Items
reward.description: This cache contains several rare items.

flashpoints.name: Joint Venture
flashpoints.description: House Steiner requires your assistance in leading a Davion-Steiner convoy across a broad swathe of hostile terrain. Payment will be remitted upon the safe delivery of the convoy's payload.

contracts.name: Joint Venture
contracts.objective: Escort the Steiner Convoy to Its Destination
contracts.description: We have eyes on Sentry Team Alpha, Commander—they're patrolling the AO, just as I said they would be. Expect moderate-to-heavy resistance on the path to your objective. As a reminder, it is absolutely vital that this convoy reach its destination. Do not disappoint me.

contracts.name: Joint Venture II
contracts.description: House Liao's occupation force is moving on our Mech Bay in force, Commander. I know that you've had no time to refit or repair your BattleMechs, but I'm going to need your assistance all the same. In light of this, I've authorized the deployment of a Steiner asset—the very rare and precious BattleMech that you just delivered to this site—to assist you, with one of my own MechWarriors to pilot it.

reward.title: Uncommon Items
reward.description: This cache contains several uncommon items.

flashpoints.name: Kurita Alliance
flashpoints.description: Our allies in the Draconis Combine have a special request for us. They insist that they can only give us details in person.

contracts.name: Kurita Alliance
contracts.objective: Destroy the Convoy and Extract to Safety
contracts.description: The ISF believes that Nephrite has already made planetfall and is tracking a FedSuns convoy moving out from the landing site. It's probable that the target is in the convoy; if we strike now, we should be able to end this little insurrection before it even begins. Engage the vehicles and destroy them all. Then, our people will sort through the remains and see if we hit our target. If we're lucky, we'll be done with this in time for dinner.

contracts.name: Kurita Alliance II
contracts.objective: Destroy the Rasalhague Terrorist and Escape
contracts.description: We have a new report from the ISF, Commander. They've located a heavily armed lance of 'Mechs in the badlands of this cold and unpleasant planet. They're way outside the usual FedSuns patrol routes, which leads my staff to suspect this is our target, moving with a significant escort to whatever their meeting place is. If they go to ground, it's going to be extremely challenging to dig them back out, so let's avoid that eventuality by intercepting this lance immediately and turning them all into smoking craters.

contracts.name: Kurita Alliance III
contracts.description: I still believe this approach is a mistake, Commander, but I'll continue to defer to your judgment. For both our sakes, let's hope you're right and that capturing this base will be a better long-term plan than simply obliterating it. The ISF reports that the facility is defended by both Davion 'Mechs and turrets, which strongly suggests there's something there worth protecting. You'll need to eliminate any hostile forces before my people can move in and sweep the base for our target.

contracts.name: Kurita Alliance IV
contracts.objective: Secure the Facility and Designate the Fire Mission's Target
contracts.description: Frankly, Commander, I'm surprised you're not as frustrated and exhausted by this situation as I am; after all, you've had to be the boots on the ground, so to speak, of this entire farce. I've decided to forestall any possible future problems by literally bringing the big guns to bear on the situation. I have a military DropShip, the Fujin, waiting on station, and you're going to provide it with targeting information. Nephrite is in a fortified bunker, meeting right this moment with representatives from both Davion and Steiner. I'm tired of chasing them. Let's obliterate them instead.

contracts.name: Kurita Alliance III
contracts.objective: Destroy the Enemy Facility and Extract Safely
contracts.description: I'm pleased we could agree that the direct approach is likely to be the most effective. The facility that the ISF believes Nephrite is hiding in is in a god-awful frozen wasteland. It shouldn't be too heavily defended, but there will probably be turrets. Remember that we need that facility flattened. Once the place is nothing but rubble, my people will search the ruins for our Rasalhague friend and confirm the kill. And then we can all go home, and honestly, I cannot wait. This place is wretched.

contracts.name: Kurita Alliance IV
contracts.objective: Secure the Facility and Designate the Fire Mission's Target
contracts.description: Frankly, Commander, I'm surprised you're not as frustrated and exhausted by this situation as I am; after all, you've had to be the boots on the ground, so to speak, of this entire farce. I've decided to forestall any possible future problems by literally bringing the big guns to bear on the situation. I have a military DropShip, the Fujin, waiting on station, and you're going to provide it with targeting information. Nephrite is in a fortified bunker, meeting right this moment with representatives from both Davion and Steiner. I'm tired of chasing them. Let's obliterate them instead.

reward.title: LosTech Items
reward.description: This cache contains several items, including at least one Star League era item.

flashpoints.name: Liao Alliance
flashpoints.description: Our allies in the Capellan Confederation have a special request for us. They insist that they can only give us details in person.

contracts.name: Liao Alliance
contracts.description: The situation planetside is deteriorating rapidly. Two Federated Suns lances are closing rapidly on our team's location, and without immediate intervention the operation will fail. I need you to intercept those 'Mechs and disable them before moving on to the facility where our covert team is hiding. You may handle this situation as you see fit; I have every confidence in you and your people, Commander.

contracts.name: Liao Alliance II
contracts.description: I wish I could offer you more time to rearm and reequip, Commander, but I'm not sure how much longer the Maskirovka team can hold out. It's only a matter of time before someone looks into the hangar where my people are hiding and the shooting starts. We need to take that facility before the Davion forces realize they have unwelcome guests. Thankfully they don't seem to have gone on higher alert, so the base should be relatively undefended, at least as far as any facility on the Federated Suns border can be undefended.

contracts.name: Liao Alliance III
contracts.description: My Maskirovka liaison wishes me to convey her thanks, Commander. We recognize that this is making your job more difficult, but the Confederation has significant plans, currently in progress, that your help in this matter will facilitate. That said, we've received word that several Davion lances are en route to the facility to retake it. I need you to hold that facility, Commander. Loading the materials aboard the transport vehicles will take time, and until it's complete, we cannot move our people.

contracts.name: Liao Alliance IV
contracts.objective: Capture the Convoy Rally Point, Escort the Convoy to Safety, and Extract
contracts.description: Our convoy is making good progress, Commander, but there's a small problem. My people are reporting the way forward is thick with Federated Suns forces, and the moment they spot the convoy, they'll converge on it, and that will be the end of our operation. I need you to deploy a lance to clear the way to the extraction zone, and keep it clear while our Leopard comes in for the pickup. The LZ is likely to be extremely hot, Commander, and the enemy will be targeting the vehicles. You need to keep them alive and get them onto that DropShip.

contracts.name: Liao Alliance III
contracts.description: Before the Maskirovka team can transport the scientists to the extraction point, we need to deal with the Davion forces that are closing on our position. We've located two lances of 'Mechs that are inbound, and I need you to intercept them before they get here. Once they're dealt with, we can start moving the team, and the scientists, to the extraction point. And Commander… I apologize for my curt tone earlier. I didn't brief you fully, and that was unprofessional of me.

contracts.name: Liao Alliance IV
contracts.objective: Capture the Convoy Rally Point, Escort the Convoy to Safety, and Extract
contracts.description: Our convoy is making good progress, Commander, but there's a small problem. My people are reporting the way forward is thick with Federated Suns forces, and the moment they spot the convoy, they'll converge on it, and that will be the end of our operation. I need you to deploy a lance to clear the way to the extraction zone, and keep it clear while our Leopard comes in for the pickup. The LZ is likely to be extremely hot, Commander, and the enemy will be targeting the vehicles. You need to keep them alive and get them onto that DropShip.

reward.title: LosTech Items
reward.description: This cache contains several items, including at least one Star League era item.

flashpoints.name: Marik Alliance
flashpoints.description: Our allies in the Free Worlds League have a special request for us. They insist that they can only give us details in person.

contracts.name: Marik Alliance
contracts.objective: Destroy the Liao Facility and Extract Safely
contracts.description: The communications facility has not been alerted to our presence, as we'd hoped, Commander. That means we will be able to land your team unnoticed and disable the facility. The defenses will be light; it has one lance as a garrison and one lance as a patrol element, plus fixed gun emplacements. However, I'd still recommend caution, given the limited force strength we were able to drop and still remain covert. As mentioned, the covert approach means we have limited intel about the base itself, so you'll be operating somewhat blind at first.

contracts.name: Marik Alliance II
contracts.objective: Destroy the Convoy and Extract Safely
contracts.description: The vehicles seem to be a standard supply convoy, with an escorting lance. It was simple bad luck that they happened to be scheduled to arrive just after we neutralized the base. We need to eliminate them before they arrive here and see League salvage and intel teams all over their facility. I wouldn't expect more than a single lance as an escort, but it's possible the vehicles themselves may pose a significant threat, given the restrictions a covert operation places on your drop tonnage.

contracts.name: Marik Alliance III
contracts.objective: Retrieve the Operative and Extract Safely
contracts.description: Our operative, Jawad, is in deep cover at the naval logistics base on this tiny island, Commander. Once you arrive at the facility, he'll break cover and board your unit in the rumble seat. Then you just need to get him and the data he carries out of the facility. We'll have the Leopard on standby to pick you up. Because you're going in quiet, the facility shouldn't be alerted to our insertion, and the opposition should be light.

contracts.name: Marik Alliance IV
contracts.objective: Set Targeting Beacons for Data Transfer
contracts.description: We're approaching the joint research base, Commander. Once you're in the AO, you'll need to move up to the base and set beacons to triangulate around it so that our covert DropShip, the Airavata, can transmit the authentication code and download the research data. We have a limited window of opportunity before the Liao ships in orbit detect our presence and come to investigate, so you'll be operating under a relatively tight timeline. So far, we've managed to keep things quiet, so while I expect significant opposition, you should be able to handle it.

reward.title: LosTech Items
reward.description: This cache contains several items, including at least one Star League era item.

flashpoints.name: Operation: Flattened Earth
flashpoints.description: A seditionist group has taken root in the Capellan system of Cavalor. House Liao will handsomely reward any company that will root out and destroy these traitors to the Confederation.

contracts.name: Operation: Flattened Earth
contracts.objective: Destroy the Razorback Company Cyclops and Escape
contracts.description: Before you can rid us of the Volkovites, you're going to have to deal with Razorback Company, the hired guns they imported from the Frontier. Our surveillance drones have identified the company's command-and-control 'Mech, a CP-10-Z Cyclops. Eliminate it to cripple Razorback Company and clear a path to your real target.

contracts.name: Operation: Flattened Earth II
contracts.description: My contacts in the Maskirovka tell me that you rejected Commander Elliathy's offer. A wise decision, Commander. Bring down the remainder of Razorback Company, and nothing will stand between you and the seditionist camp.

contracts.name: Operation: Flattened Earth III
contracts.objective: Destroy the Volkovite Sanctuary and Escape
contracts.description: The remaining Volkovites have holed up in a sanctuary you'll find in this valley. Destroy it, and eliminate whatever resistance they can bring to bear. The eyes of the Chancellor are on you, Commander. Don't disappoint him.

contracts.name: Operation: Flattened Earth II
contracts.description: Good on you for being on the right side of this conflict, {COMMANDER.Callsign}… I know it couldn't have been an easy decision. And speaking of difficult matters, you're about to have a fight on your hands. House Liao has sent a detachment of 'Mechs to finish your job for you, and unfortunately, Razorback Company is no position to deal with 'em.

contracts.name: Operation: Flattened Earth III
contracts.objective: Escort the Volkovite Convoy to Safety and Escape
contracts.description: The last of the Volkovites have packed themselves onto a series of transport vehicles, and they're ready to roll. We've lined up a DropShip to take them to Joppa, but you're gonna have to get 'em there. We're nearly through this situation, Commander… just a little bit further to go.

contracts.name: Operation: Flattened Earth II
contracts.description: Good on you for being on the right side of this conflict, {COMMANDER.Callsign}… I know it couldn't have been an easy decision. And speaking of difficult matters, you're about to have a fight on your hands. House Liao has sent a detachment of 'Mechs to finish your job for you, and unfortunately, Razorback Company is no position to deal with 'em.

contracts.name: Operation: Flattened Earth III
contracts.objective: Escort the Volkovite Convoy to Safety and Escape
contracts.description: The last of the Volkovites have packed themselves onto a series of transport vehicles, and they're ready to roll. We've lined up a DropShip to take them to Joppa, but you're gonna have to get 'em there. We're nearly through this situation, Commander… just a little bit further to go.

reward.title: Rare Items
reward.description: This cache contains several rare items.

flashpoints.name: Steiner Alliance
flashpoints.description: Our allies in the Lyran Commonwealth have a special request for us. They insist that they can only give us details in person.

contracts.name: Steiner Alliance
contracts.objective: Destroy the Force Commander and Escape
contracts.description: The FWLM Force Commander is currently traveling between installations on an inspection tour. He is heavily guarded, with two escorting lances of 'Mechs piloted by veterans who have served with him for years. However, this is still the best opportunity we'll have to strike at the League's command structure in Claybrooke.

contracts.name: Steiner Alliance II
contracts.objective: Destroy the Enemy Structures and Extract Safely
contracts.description: I've received word from Margrave General Neil; our success was well received within Cavanaugh Theater Command. Margrave Neil has passed on the results of their stragetic planning session, and we've been asked to strike one of the local military installations. The goal is to completely neutralize the facility, to send a message to local forces that they are vulnerable.

contracts.name: Steiner Alliance III
contracts.objective: Attack the Installation and Place Beacons for a Fire Mission
contracts.description: I approve of your choice of 'Mechs for this mission, Commander. This ought to be just the show of force that Margrave Joss was hoping for. Also, I have additional support to provide, thanks to Kommandant General Plath; you'll need to clear the antiair defenses before the support lance can land, though. Remember: Gungnir, our DropShip, can remain on station to fire at the planet only for a limited time. Move quickly, Commander.

contracts.name: Steiner Alliance IV
contracts.objective: Destroy the Convoy and Extract Safely
contracts.description: Our strike on the military facility has presented an opportunity, Commander. The military ruler of Claybrooke, Lieutenant Colonel Chestine, is fleeing the capital for an undisclosed secure location, presumably to avoid being targeted by another strike. If we move quickly, we should be able to catch her while she's still in transit, and eliminate her. This mission was requested personally by Duchess Iris Steiner, the Margrave of Cavanaugh Theater, so it is absolutely critical that we succeed.

contracts.name: Steiner Alliance III
contracts.objective: Attack the Installation and Place the Beacons for a Fire Mission
contracts.description: I still believe that this mission would be more effective if you had chosen to bring heavier 'Mechs, but the orbital strike should still be the show of force that Margrave Joss was hoping for. Also, I have additional support to provide, thanks to Kommandant General Plath; you'll need to clear the antiair defenses before the support lance can land, though. Remember: Gungnir, our DropShip, can remain on station to fire at the planet only for a limited time. Move quickly, Commander.

contracts.name: Steiner Alliance IV
contracts.objective: Capture the Convoy Rally Point, Escort the Convoy to Safety, and Extract
contracts.description: Our strike on the military facility has presented an opportunity, Commander. The military ruler of Claybrooke, Lieutenant Colonel Chestine, is fleeing the capital for an undisclosed secure location, presumably to avoid being targeted by another strike. If we move quickly, we should be able to intercept her convoy and take her captive. This mission was requested personally by Duchess Iris Steiner, the Margrave of Cavanaugh Theater, so it is absolutely critical that we succeed.

reward.title: LosTech Item
reward.description: This cache contains a single Star League era item.

flashpoints.name: The Baying of Hounds
flashpoints.description: You aren't gonna believe this, but Morgan Kell—the Morgan Kell, of the Kell Hounds—wants us for a job. This isn't the sort of offer you say no to.

contracts.name: The Baying of Hounds
contracts.objective: Destroy the Beasts of Balawat's Modified Stalker
contracts.description: The Beasts of Balawat have units scattered all across this basin. More importantly, they've got a monster LRM boat that needs to go down before we can even try to move the convoy to a landing site. It's an assault 'Mech, Stalker-class, heavily modified for indirect fire. Destroy it and proceed to the rendezvous site.

contracts.name: The Baying of Hounds II
contracts.objective: Rendezvous with Tempest's Convoy and Escort It to the Evac Point
contracts.description: With the LRM Stalker down, you should be clear to rendezvous with Tempest's convoy. Escort the vehicles to the pickup point, and get them there in one piece. All other considerations are secondary.

contracts.name: The Baying of Hounds III
contracts.description: This will be a difficult fight, Commander. The Beasts of Balawat are former Kell Hounds; they've received some of the best training and equipment you'll find anywhere. But more than that, they've got something to prove.

contracts.name: The Baying of Hounds III
contracts.objective: Capture the Beasts of Balawat's Armory
contracts.description: The Beasts of Balawat's armory is just ahead of you, Commander. Strike swiftly, take the facility, and hold it until Megan and Tempest can be extracted. The Kell Hounds and I will handle Rhee and her people. Let's do this.

reward.title: Rare Items
reward.description: This cache contains several rare items.

flashpoints.name: The Defector
flashpoints.description: An agent of the Combine government has gone rogue. He must be prevented from sharing what he knows, and I believe that a mercenary solution is in order. Kill the defector and you will be rewarded.

contracts.name: The Defector
contracts.objective: Ambush and Destroy Yoshito Okada's Convoy
contracts.description: Your lance will be dropping directly in the path of Yoshito Okada's convoy. Smash it flat—there can be no survivors. When the defector's death has been confirmed, you will receive your reward.

contracts.name: The Defector II
contracts.objective: Eliminate the Defector's Convoy and Extract Safely
contracts.description: You've chosen to complete your contract, to satisfy your obligation to House Kurita. Good. On my honor, you will receive your pay when Okada is dead—and not a moment before.

contracts.name: The Defector II
contracts.description: You dare take up arms against the Galedon Regulars?! Your hubris will destroy you, mercenary dog—and I will personally put your broken corpse into the ground!

reward.title: LosTech Items
reward.description: This cache contains several items, including at least one Star League era item.

flashpoints.name: The Long Hunt
flashpoints.summary: Branch B has an additional choice, leading to b2 or c1.
flashpoints.description: A Davion lieutenant has committed terrible atrocities in the Combine system of Shaul Khala. I need you to hunt him down, Commander. He cannot be permitted to live after what he's done.

contracts.name: The Long Hunt
contracts.description: My agents have traced Colonel Basil Lees to a stronghold in the basin ahead. I want you to raze it to the ground, and destroy anything that attempts to protect it. Show this Davion animal what the Draconis Combine does to those who would slaughter its people.

contracts.name: The Long Hunt II
contracts.description: The sensor array that you'll need to capture to escape this system is further ahead, but there are Davion 'Mechs between you and the facility. Kill them before they kill you.

contracts.name: The Long Hunt III
contracts.description: The Davion sensor array you'll need to capture is just ahead, Commander. Take it, and Ms. Meyer will have what she needs to neutralize Lees's threat to the Argo.

contracts.name: The Long Hunt II
contracts.description: My people on the ground have picked up a lance of Davion BattleMechs on their sensors, Commander. If you move on Lees without dealing with them, they'll be in position to outflank you.

contracts.name: The Long Hunt IV
contracts.description: Colonel Lees's stronghold is just ahead of you, Commander. For all his arrogant bluster, it would seem that the Butcher of Shaul Khala is a coward at heart. I've seen no sign that he intends to meet you on the field of battle. So be it; if he won't leave his fortress voluntarily, then I will have your BattleMechs remove him by force.

reward.title: Rare Items
reward.description: This cache contains several rare items.

flashpoints.name: The Opportunist
flashpoints.description: House Davion requests your assistance in the transportation and custodial exchange of a high-profile prisoner. Payment will be remitted when the asset is in our hands.

contracts.name: The Opportunist
contracts.objective: Escort the Prison Transport to the Repair Bay
contracts.description: Ms. Hadley's prison transport is waiting for you on the planet's surface, Commander. You will meet with it at a designated rendezvous point, then escort it to a distant repair bay. The personnel there stand ready to hold Ms. Hadley and patch up the prison transport APCs. When they're finished, you'll be free to press on to the extraction point.

contracts.name: The Opportunist II
contracts.description: Our sensors indicate several large groups of incoming vehicles and BattleMechs, Commander. Whoever they are, I need you to hold them off and drive them away. Above all, they cannot be allowed to free Ms. Hadley from confinement. She belongs to us.

contracts.name: The Opportunist III
contracts.objective: Take Over the Artillery Control Facility
contracts.description: I'm glad that you decided to listen to reason, Commander—you'd be surprised how many so-called mercenaries lack the savvy to jump on an opportunity like this when it presents itself. Now, the LosTech cache that I'm sending you after is close to our location, but there's a catch: it's sealed away in a defunct mineshaft. I've got a way in, though. Follow my instructions, and we'll all get rich.

contracts.name: The Opportunist III
contracts.objective: Escort the Prison Transport to Lady Cunningham's DropShip
contracts.description: I've received the coordinates for the rendezvous point from Lady Cunningham, Commander… we should be ready to roll when you are. I haven't managed to get Lady Cunningham herself on the horn—some kind of atmospheric interference is scrambling our long-range comms. But it should be pretty straightforward, all things said.

reward.title: Rare Items
reward.description: This cache contains several rare items.

flashpoints.name: The Steel Beast
flashpoints.description: A Solaris gladiator has murdered my nephew, Arjun. With your help, I will see his killer brought to justice, Commander—make him suffer and I'll make you rich.

contracts.name: The Steel Beast
contracts.description: If we are to draw the Steel Beast into a fight, we must first provoke him. The wholesale slaughter of his revolting followers seems like a reasonable first step. I'll point you in the right direction, you'll bring the firepower, and we'll scour this world of Bogdan Tubbs's fan club. Then we'll move on to a more high-profile target.

contracts.name: The Steel Beast II
contracts.description: Ironwood Productions' Holo-distribution facility is just ahead of you, Commander. Take it, and we will use it to ensure that the Steel Beast hears your challenge.

contracts.name: The Steel Beast III
contracts.description: This is it, Commander. Your one-on-one contest with the Steel Beast. Give him the justice he so richly deserves!

contracts.name: The Steel Beast III
contracts.description: This is it, Commander. Your lance versus the Steel Beast, and whatever reinforcements he dares to call. Give him the justice he so richly deserves!

reward.title: Rare 'Mech
reward.description: This cache contains a single Star League era item.

flashpoints.name: Unwelcome Guests
flashpoints.description: House Marik requests your assistance in removing an unwelcome Steiner presence from its territory. Bring a light lance and your best pilots; in this deployment, speed will be of the essence.

contracts.name: Unwelcome Guests
contracts.description: House Steiner has constructed a military stronghold within our territorial boundaries. We have artillery in place to destroy it, but we need you to place targeting beacons in key locations before we can pull the trigger. While you work, a mercenary lance from Gwydion Company will keep any Steiner reinforcements off your backs.

contracts.name: Unwelcome Guests II
contracts.description: Carronade sends her thanks for the assist, Commander—we're doing Gwydion Company a solid that a lot of other mercenary commands wouldn't. Our friends have taken shelter in a subterranean bunker, and a Steiner kill team has them penned in. Carronade needs us to engage and destroy the Lyrans so that she and her people can escape.

contracts.name: Unwelcome Guests II
contracts.objective: Destroy the Marik Structures and Escape
contracts.description: I'm so pleased that you've chosen to work with us, Commander. You destroyed one of our facilities at the behest of House Marik; it seems only fair that you do the same for us. Turnabout is fair play, after all. The facility will be minimally guarded, and your pay will be extremely generous.

reward.title: LosTech Items
reward.description: This cache contains several items, including at least one Star League era item.

flashpoints.name: White Lies
flashpoints.summary: Branch B has the extra encounter
flashpoints.description: I require your assistance with a personal matter, Commander. Meet me at the specified location, and come quick—my family needs your help.

contracts.name: White Lies
contracts.description: Before we can eliminate the person responsible for attacking my family, we must identify him. His mercenary cat's-paws, Arslan's Janissaries, have a base of operations at our first drop site. You will seize the base from them. My forensics team will then scour their computers to put a name to their employer.

contracts.name: White Lies II
contracts.description: According to the information my team pulled from the base you captured, our target—my enemy—is one Murdoch Dhawan, a small-time political extremist from Kilarney. He's here, in this basin. Destroy him and you will be well rewarded.

contracts.name: White Lies II
contracts.description: According to the information recovered by my forensics team, our target—the person responsible for my family's suffering—is Lord Parzival Gurung, the head of a minor noble house from Atreus. Lord Gurung is well connected and well defended. If we're going to capture him, first we must strike against his bodyguard.

contracts.name: White Lies III
contracts.description: With Lord Gurung's bodyguard in ruins, we are clear to advance on the armory he's taking refuge in. When the building is ours, I will deal with the man personally. He will pay for what his hirelings have done to my family.

reward.title: Rare Items
reward.description: This cache contains several rare items.

flashpoints.name: Hourglass
flashpoints.description: Our intel was right, Commander. Surface scans show that the Dobrev is moored at a makeshift spaceport near Appian's southern pole. We can take it, but we'll need to move fast.

contracts.name: Hourglass
contracts.objective: Capture the Baumann Group Security Complex
contracts.description: As per our earlier discussion, I'm going to drop you right on top of a Baumann Group security outpost some 20 klicks from the Dobrev's spaceport. You're going to have to capture the site and clear out its defenses. When the job's done, the Moderbjörn will use the complex's computers to drop the spaceport's defenses and remotely engage the Dobrev's docking clamps. I'd expect the OpFor's defenses to run heavy on this one, so I'd advise building your lance accordingly.

contracts.name: Hourglass II
contracts.objective: Protect the Evacuated Spaceport from the Black Widow Company
contracts.description: The Dobrev is gone, but its crew left an undefined amount of valuable contraband behind at the spaceport. Unfortunately, the Black Widow wants to melt every scrap of that contraband to slag. The Moderbjörn will draw the Black Widow's attention away from our AO, which should buy Yang and me enough time to ransack the spaceport. We'll be relying on your lance to protect us from anyone else who might come along.

reward.title: Rare 'Mech
reward.description: This cache contains a single rare 'Mech.

flashpoints.name: Hunting Season
flashpoints.description: This is exciting, Commander—our first real lead in the hunt for the Dobrev! If we find that derelict, we may find the answer to the single greatest mystery of our age!

contracts.name: Hunting Season
contracts.description: Like I said, the Baumann Group's distribution center is heavily defended, so we're gonna approach this as a two-stage operation. For this first stage, you're going to descend at the outermost edge of the OpFor's territory and engage their patrolling cavalry. Take out as many vehicles and 'Mechs as you can to clear the way for an assault on the distribution center.

reward.title: Rare Items
reward.description: This cache contains two rare items.

flashpoints.name: Of Unknown Origin
flashpoints.description: Commander. I have an important task for you, a rescue operation at the utmost edge of the Rimward Frontier. Meet me at Tarragona and I'll fill you in on the details.

contracts.name: Of Unknown Origin
contracts.description: According to ISF intelligence, Captain Gaku Magorian is being held prisoner in one of a dozen safe houses within the boundaries of Alamedo Province. Obviously, we can't rely on trial and error to find him, so we're going to have to narrow down the list. Our unidentified syndicate is known to maintain a forward base in this AO. Capture it so that Dr. Murad can scour the OpFor's mainframe for confirmation of Captain Magorian's whereabouts.

contracts.name: Of Unknown Origin II
contracts.description: Zeta Lance moved Captain Magorian out of Alamedo Province two days ago. They're holding him in a bunker somewhere under the ruins of New Vulci, a city that fell victim to a nuclear accident in 2977. Engage Zeta Lance and destroy their 'Mechs. When you're finished, I'll scour their combat computers for the bunker's coordinates.

contracts.name: Of Unknown Origin III
contracts.objective: Destroy the Baumann Group armory and all defending units
contracts.description: I'm dropping you at the Baumann Group's armory, Commander. Hit it hard enough, and the prison's garrison should come running, clearing the way for the Moderbjörn to rescue Captain Magorian with its drones.

contracts.name: Of Unknown Origin III
contracts.objective: Retrieve Captain Gaku Magorian and Extract Safely
contracts.description: Captain Magorian is being held in a subterranean bunker attached to a complex just ahead of us. We're going to sneak a scout lance in, rescue the captain, and bug out. If all goes according to plan, the Moderbjörn's combat drones will distract the bunker's garrison and keep it out of our hair for the duration of the operation.

reward.title: Rare Item
reward.description: This cache contains a single rare item.

flashpoints.name: Standoff
flashpoints.description: This is a point of no return, Commander. When you pull the trigger on this drop, you may well be committing us to a confrontation with the Black Widow. We’d better be ready.

contracts.name: Standoff
contracts.description: We've found the Dobrev, and this time, it's in no condition to run. Time is of the essence here, so we're going to deploy alongside the Moderbjörn's drones. Hit the Baumann Group fast, hit 'em hard, and wipe the AO clean. After we've taken the Dobrev, we'll discuss our next steps.

contracts.name: Standoff II
contracts.objective: Defeat the Black Widow and the Bounty Hunter
contracts.description: This is it—the final confrontation between ourselves, the Black Widow, and the Bounty Hunter. Succeed in this, and the Moderbjörn will have all the time it needs to harvest the Dobrev's navigation logs. The secrets of the Star League lie within our grasp, Commander. I know we can do this, so let's get to it.

reward.title: Rare Items
reward.description: This cache contains two rare items.

flashpoints.name: A House Divided
flashpoints.description: Commander, I need your help—my house's honor is at stake. Please, let's meet and discuss the details.

contracts.name: A House Divided
contracts.description: My daughter will arrive shortly at a private compound, and Luthendorff is on the way to greet her. Intercept and eliminate this criminal. But be on guard—she has bodyguards with her, although I expect you to easily outmaneuver and outsmart them.

contracts.name: A House Divided II
contracts.description: Luthendorff will not escape death again, Commander. Don't expect an easy fight. This time she'll be prepared for us. I'm picking up multiple heavy contacts on my sensors. More scrap for Luthendorff's funeral pyre.

contracts.name: A House Divided II
contracts.description: Lady Suiko is inbound, and she's not alone. Her old war buddies are moving in fast-two lances of 'em. Keep in mind, we've got one goal: stop her from killing Luthendorff.

reward.title: Rare Item
reward.description: This cache contains a single rare item.

flashpoints.name: Double Agent
flashpoints.description: The Capellan Confederation requires your assistance on a highly sensitive matter. Meet me at Flintoft, Commander. We'll discuss the details there.

contracts.name: Double Agent
contracts.description: The Federated Suns have constructed a forward base in the no-man's-land between their territory and ours on Flintoft's northern continent. We need you to eliminate their garrison and capture that base. We will remit payment when you've completed the job and secured the base.

contracts.name: Double Agent II
contracts.description: We've received your message, and Maskirovka agents are on their way to take possession of the facility. Be advised that our long-range sensors have detected Davion and Taurian military DropShips en route to an AO near your position. To better protect the facility, we suggest that you engage them there. We'll supply you with reinforcements of our own as soon as we can.

contracts.name: Double Agent II
contracts.description: We've received your message, and TMI agents are on their way to take possession of the facility. Be advised that our long-range sensors have detected Davion and Liao military DropShips en route to an AO near your position. To better protect the facility, we suggest that you engage them there. We'll supply you with reinforcements of our own as soon as we can.

contracts.name: Double Agent II
contracts.description: We've received your message, and MIM operatives are on their way to reclaim our wounded agent. Be advised that our long-range sensors have detected Taurian and Liao military DropShips en route to an AO near your position. To better protect our agent, we suggest that you engage them there, away from the facility. We'll supply you with reinforcements of our own as soon as we can.

reward.title: Rare Item
reward.description: This cache contains a single rare item.

flashpoints.name: Hearts and Minds
flashpoints.description: A pro-Capellan insurgent group called the Emerald Dawn threatens to destabilize Shaunavon's political landscape. House Davion will reward you handsomely to neutralize this terrorist threat.

contracts.name: Hearts and Minds
contracts.description: Matis "Bishop" Crenshaw and his retinue are en route to a meeting with Sian Triumphant, a satellite organization of the Emerald Dawn. Intercept Crenshaw's BattleMech, destroy it, and contact my DropShip to confirm the kill.

contracts.name: Hearts and Minds II
contracts.description: Tiesa "Navaja" Norkus has holed up in the Emerald Dawn's most heavily fortified stronghold, and she's using a number of civilian hostages as human shields. Unfortunately, there isn't much that we can do for those people; Lady Cunningham has made it very clear that eliminating the Emerald Dawn's leadership is imperative, and it'll be impossible for us to take out Norkus without incurring collateral damage.

contracts.name: Hearts and Minds II
contracts.description: We may not be able to take out Tiesa Norkus, but at least we can contain her. If she wants to hide behind human shields, fine—let her hide. We'll do as much damage to the Emerald Dawn as we can, and when Lady Cunningham's DropShip touches down, she can handle the hostage negotiations.

reward.title: Uncommon Weapon
reward.description: This cache contains an improved version of a 'Mech weapon.

flashpoints.name: One Man's Trash
flashpoints.description: Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. You don't know me, but me and my associates have a job for you. A real nice one, with a big payout at the end. If you wanna talk about it, come meet me at Glentworth. I'll be waiting.

contracts.name: One Man's Trash
contracts.objective: Loot the Star League Stapler Factory
contracts.description: I've given your pilot a map of Men Lojowen, complete with the rough location of the Star League installation. I want you to get in there, brush aside any resistance, and loot whatever your BattleMechs can carry. You'll get your pay when my associates have the goods.

contracts.name: One Man's Trash II
contracts.description: The last time I checked, Binton and Modge had a bunch of combat vehicles in the streets around my time-share. Maybe a light 'Mech or two, I can't say for sure. Get 'em off my back, and then we'll conclude our business with the antique staplers.

contracts.name: One Man's Trash II
contracts.description: I've told Binton and Modge that you're gonna drop their "treasure" in a field about a hundred klicks southeast of Louth Abbey. That should put you far enough away to avoid collateral damage, so feel free to go after 'em with whatever BattleMechs you like. Just be aware that there's nothing stopping them from doin' the same to you.

reward.title: Uncommon Upgrade
reward.description: This cache contains an improved version of a 'Mech upgrade component.

flashpoints.name: Prototype
flashpoints.description: I have a highly delicate contract that requires your immediate attention. The task at hand is sensitive to the point that it cannot be discussed over an open channel. Meet me in the Duchy of Andurien and I'll fill you in on the details.

contracts.name: Prototype
contracts.objective: Rendezvous with Bravo Lance and Clear the AO
contracts.description: For your first deployment, you will take the field alongside Ombra and the rest of Bravo Lance. Together, you will sweep the AO for hostiles, eliminating any Capellan units you find along the way. Bravo Lance has endured a great deal of punishment over the past few months and will need your help to come through this deployment in one piece.

contracts.name: Prototype II
contracts.description: According to Ombra, a Black Caldera convoy has been scheduled to pass through the badlands north of New Jakobstad. Engage the convoy and destroy it. Bravo Lance will then interface with the command vehicle's black box to obtain the location of the Raven prototype, as well as the R&D facility Black Caldera has been using to reverse engineer it.

contracts.name: Prototype III
contracts.description: According to the intel we found, Black Caldera Defense is storing their stolen Raven prototype at an old armory in southern New Jakobstad. We need to capture the base and recover the prototype. Conqueror, Viscacha, and Peregrine will be standing by to carry out the second half of the operation when we're done.

contracts.name: Prototype IV
contracts.objective: Destroy the Black Caldera R&D Facility
contracts.description: According to the intel we found, Black Caldera's hardened R&D facility is protected by a phalanx of LRM batteries. Using the Raven's unique capabilities, you will protect Bravo Lance from these weapons while leading them to destroy the facility.

reward.title: Rare 'Mech
reward.description: This cache contains a single rare 'Mech.

flashpoints.name: Red Hunt
flashpoints.description: Commander! I'm glad I was able to reach you. I have an opportunity for your company that pays extremely well. The only drawback is that it's located as far from civilization as it's possible to get without a JumpShip accident.

contracts.name: Red Hunt I
contracts.objective: Defend the Draconis Combine Research Base
contracts.description: Commander, this installation is a vital part of Combine research efforts, and we need to ensure the enemy doesn't destroy it. We believe the opposing forces are a mercenary unit hired by our erstwhile allies in the Free Worlds League, and their intent is to disrupt the important work being done here. Your job will be to hold them off until they exhaust themselves, at which point we'll launch our own counterattack.

contracts.name: Red Hunt II
contracts.description: It looks like we're both on the Kurita shit list, Commander. This situation is bad and getting worse. My people are pinned down by fire from the DEST forces, and we can't use our Leopard to get into orbit. We've evacuated the Fire Lance, but the Command Lance is still stuck on-world—which concerns me personally, because I'm part of the Command Lance and one of the people who's stuck. I want to get to the bottom of this mess, but I'm going to need your help.

contracts.name: Red Hunt III
contracts.description: Commander, we're prepared to start our assault on the ComStar facility. Before we make our move, we need you to take out that military base, so that DEST can't coordinate a response. Once that base is rubble, give us the all clear. Then we'll commence our attack, break in there, and broadcast the signal to Tor.

contracts.name: Red Hunt III
contracts.description: Commander, we're starting our assault. As soon as we take out the Combine military base, the Kuritans will lose their ability to coordinate a response. That's your cue to move in and capture the ComStar facility, shut down the jamming gear DEST set up there, and get our signal broadcasting. We've got a pretty big window before Tor leaves again, so the only hurry is that our DEST friends aren't going to sit on their hands after we start shooting at them.

reward.title: LosTech Items
reward.description: This cache contains several items, including at least one Star League era item.

flashpoints.name: Siegebreaker
flashpoints.description: House Steiner has placed a Capellan city under military blockade. With your assistance, I intend to break the Lyran siege.

contracts.name: Siegebreaker
contracts.description: For your first deployment, you will rendezvous with Azura "Cheval" Damestroir of the Mitchel Planetary Militia. She and her lance have been scout-hunting in northern Gauthier's wealthy Museum District, and it appears that they've caught a Lyran scout. Assist her lance in defeating it, then proceed to your next rendezvous point.

contracts.name: Siegebreaker II
contracts.description: Your next objective is in Jessup Downs, on the far side of Gauthier. Your point of contact, a former militia member and paroled felon who operates under the callsign "Jailbird," has been holding the Downs with no outside support for nearly a month. She has reported signs of a heavy Steiner patrol lance moving through the area. I need you to assist her in bringing down that patrol.

contracts.name: Siegebreaker III
contracts.objective: Destroy the Ziegelhaus While Protecting Militia HQ
contracts.description: Even with a portion of Dobrescu's sentries out chasing shadows in the Museum District, the Ziegelhaus will be heavily defended. You'll need to hit the structure hard, while at the same time protecting Militia HQ from an expected Steiner counterattack. Good hunting, Commander. Show Hauptmann-General Dobrescu that his excesses will not be tolerated.

reward.title: Rare Upgrade
reward.description: This cache contains a high-end improved 'Mech upgrade component.

flashpoints.name: Succession
flashpoints.description: An associate of mine on Primus is in desperate need of assistance. If you're open to a little subcontracting, I'll make it worth your while.

contracts.name: Succession
contracts.description: Commander Yuetu and her Red Hare Irregulars have proven an intolerable threat to my interests and to the future of House Khulan. I need you to hunt her down and destroy her BattleMech, an "Orion," I believe it's called. Smash it to pieces and bring me proof of Yuetu's death, and I will lend Shugo Yamaguchi my support.

contracts.name: Succession II
contracts.description: The vile mercenary Yuetu is on her last legs. Cut them out from under her! Safeguard my beloved son, and prevent our enemies from destroying House Khulan. If you do, I will see to Reynauld's needs, and he in turn will see to yours.

contracts.name: Succession II
contracts.description: You'll find my brother waiting for you at the Red Roost. It looks like a commercial office park, but don't be fooled. The structure is reinforced to withstand military payloads. Engage my brother's security team and raze the Red Roost. Let his stronghold serve as his tomb!

reward.title: Rare Weapon
reward.description: This cache contains a high-end improved 'Mech weapon.

flashpoints.name: Tournament of Champions
flashpoints.description: Your deeds on the field of battle have earned you an invitation to my Tournament of Champions. Join us, and take your place in the arena against the Periphery's fiercest warriors!

contracts.name: Tournament of Champions
contracts.objective: Win the first round of the Tournament
contracts.description: Welcome to my Tournament, Commander. Here you will prove your mettle against the Periphery's fiercest champions. Today, your MechWarriors will demonstrate their worth using only the simplest of tools: the UM-R60 UrbanMech. Like a huntsman's spear, it is an instrument with a single purpose. Wield it skillfully, and ascend into triumph.

contracts.name: Tournament of Champions II
contracts.objective: Defeat Professor Horvat and Win the Tournament of Champions
contracts.description: Welcome to the final round of my Tournament, Commander. Today, your two finest pilots will face off against the cream of the Frontier MechWarrior community. This will be a battle like no other, a clash between veritable gods. I wish your fighters luck, Commander—and I promise you, they will need it.

contracts.name: Tournament of Champions II
contracts.description: Professor Mencius Horvat is waiting for you in the Tournament arena. He expects you to play by his rules—to let him lead a pair of your MechWarriors like lambs to the slaughter. Instead, you're going to show him the kind of firepower that your company can really bring down. Destroy him, and the MIIO will reward you accordingly.

reward.title: Cash Prize: ¢1,000,000
reward.description: This cache contains a single rare 'Mech.

flashpoints.name: Yang Virtanen's Big Score
flashpoints.description: Hey, Boss. I've got a line on a really juicy opportunity out on Electra, but I need to check it out in person to be sure. Think you could authorize taking a little detour?

contracts.name: Yang Virtanen's Big Score
contracts.objective: Capture the Hangar and Eliminate Wallo's Security Detail
contracts.description: Wallo's got a mercenary company on retainer to protect his private aerospace hangar, the imaginatively named "Security Solutions, Inc." I looked 'em up, and they're the real deal—they've got combat vehicles, BattleMechs, the works. But we'll have the element of surprise on our side, given that Wallo's never heard of us. That's something, right?

contracts.name: Yang Virtanen's Big Score II
contracts.description: Okay, Boss! We've got the hot rods, and we're on our way to the LZ. Did I mention that I still hate rumble seats? Boy, do I ever! You'd better get on the comms to guide us through this—we're moving at a solid clip, but I suspect we're being followed…

reward.title: Rare 'Mech
reward.description: This cache contains a single rare 'Mech.
